messages.author: 6d020fc5d7c9ee0a
messages.subject: Error: dims declared=(1); dims found=()
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to run a model, where some of the vectors of observations just have one value.   In the data block I have defined: 

data {
  int N_obs;
  real endtime_obs[N_obs];
}

However, I am getting an error when running optimize to get the MLE: dims declared=(1); dims found=().  I saw some old threads that discuss this issue but I have not found a solution.  I tried declaring the data as a 1 dimensional array in R, but that didn't work.  Replacing N_obs with 1 directly in the Stan code didn't work either.  Does anyone have any suggestions about the best way to solve this issue?

Thanks,
Colin

Ben
